title: Artifact visibility contract
description: Separates user-facing literature-research deliverables from diagnostic trace artifacts so the UI can show clean research outputs while keeping debugging files available for review.
changes: Define user-facing artifacts: scope, paper cards, literature map, field map, gap map, verified idea bank, review notes, and final report.
Define diagnostic artifacts: queries, search diagnostics, seed/candidate/rejected papers, claim cards, and evidence edges.
Require diagnostic artifacts to remain available for trace review without being primary user deliverables.

rollback.notes: Restore pre-idea prior-work gating without an explicit artifact visibility contract.
